gloss: first volume; upper volume (of a two- or three-part work)

definitions.explanation: The first volume of a book or work published in two or three parts. The pairing is {上巻|じょうかん} / {下巻|げかん} for two-part works, or {上巻|じょうかん} / {中巻|ちゅうかん} / {下巻|げかん} for three.

examples.english: I read the first volume first.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上巻|じょうかん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{下巻|げかん}→下巻：28432_gekan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: This novel is divided into a first volume and a second volume.

examples.japanese: {上巻|じょうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結末|けつまつ}→結末：15091_ketsumatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{衝撃的|しょうげきてき}→衝撃的：06829_shougekiteki⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{下巻|げかん}→下巻：28432_gekan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}みたく→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The ending of the first volume was shocking, and I immediately wanted to read the second.

notes:
Used for books published in two or three physical volumes. The pair is ⟦{下巻|げかん}→下巻：28432_gekan⟧ (second volume); for three-part sets, {中巻|ちゅうかん} (middle volume) is added in between.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上巻|じょうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: read the first volume
- {上巻|じょうかん}・⟦{下巻|げかん}→下巻：28432_gekan⟧: first and second volumes (set notation)
- {上巻|じょうかん}⟦{発売中|はつばいちゅう}→発売中：22137_hatsubaichuu⟧: first volume on sale now

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下巻|げかん}→下巻：28432_gekan⟧: second / last volume — the pair of {上巻|じょうかん}
- {第一巻|だいいっかん}: volume 1 — used for numbered series of any length
- {前編|ぜんぺん}: first part — used more for stories told in installments (films, articles)
